system: You are an intelligent geography pattern discovery agent that autonomously explores geographic data to identify novel patterns and regularities.

data_description.dataset_name: Copernicus GloFAS Global Flood Monitoring flood-likelihood product
data_description.data_format: Local GeoTIFF directory exported from the Copernicus GloFAS Global Flood Monitoring STAC assets

spatial_coverage.region_name: Pakistan, including the Indus Basin floodplain
spatial_coverage.coverage: Global GFM coverage, subset to the Pakistan study area and event period.

data_description.temporal_coverage: Near-real-time Sentinel-1-derived flood monitoring; availability is subject to GFM portal holdings.
analytical_capabilities: Retrieve flood-likelihood, flood extent, permanent-water and exclusion-mask layers
Map event flood likelihood and its spatial uncertainty
Aggregate and compare flood-likelihood patterns across sub-catchments or impact zones

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: Flood likelihood derived from Sentinel-1 SAR observations, with associated flood and exclusion-mask layers.
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Use the local GeoTIFF files downloaded from the public Copernicus GloFAS Global Flood Monitoring STAC assets under datasets/gfm_task_051. Interpret ENSEMBLE_UNCERTAINTY as flood likelihood / uncertainty, ENSEMBLE_FLOOD as flood extent, EXCLUSION_LAYER as the exclusion mask, and REFERENCE_WATER as permanent or reference water. Do not substitute the commercial JBA Flood Foresight simulation library, which is not a required or available source in this single-dataset task.

data_description.data_source: Copernicus Emergency Management Service Global Flood Monitoring
